### [The Anthropic Economic Index connector](https://www.anthropic.com/news/anthropic-economic-index-connector)

**Anthropic** · 2026-07-22

Anthropic has launched the Anthropic Economic Index connector for Claude, allowing users to directly explore data on AI's economic usage and its impact on jobs and tasks.

- The Anthropic Economic Index connector enables direct exploration of data measuring AI usage in the economy via Claude.
- Users can ask Claude questions about the Index data, receiving answers grounded in the dataset.
- The connector is accessible in claude.ai through the connectors menu, works with any Claude model, and requires no installation.
- Claude can provide underlying data for answers and will highlight the Index's limitations, which reflect Claude usage patterns rather than the entire labor market.
- The full datasets of the Anthropic Economic Index remain freely available on Anthropic's website.

**Why it matters:** This connector democratizes access to economic data on AI's impact, making it available to a broader audience beyond researchers, journalists, and policymakers.

`ai` `economic-index` `claude` `connector` `data-exploration`

### [Introducing Claude Design by Anthropic Labs](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-design-anthropic-labs)

**Anthropic** · 2026-07-22

Anthropic Labs launched Claude Design, a new product powered by Claude Opus 4.7, enabling collaboration with Claude to create and refine visual work like designs, prototypes, and slides.

- Claude Design is powered by the Claude Opus 4.7 vision model.
- It allows refinement through conversation, inline comments, direct edits, or custom sliders.
- Claude Design can automatically apply a team's design system by reading codebase and design files.
- Input methods include text prompts, uploaded images/documents (DOCX, PPTX, XLSX), codebase pointing, and web capture.
- Designs can be exported to Canva, PDF, PPTX, standalone HTML, or as a handoff bundle for Claude Code.

**Why it matters:** This tool streamlines visual content creation and design system adherence for both experienced designers and non-designers, facilitating broader exploration and consistent branding.

### [Introducing Claude for Small Business](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-for-small-business)

**Anthropic** · 2026-07-22

Anthropic launched Claude for Small Business, a package of connectors and workflows integrating Claude AI into tools like QuickBooks, PayPal, and HubSpot to automate tasks for small businesses.

- Claude for Small Business is a toggle install that integrates Claude into existing small business tools such as Intuit QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, Docusign, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365.
- It includes 15 ready-to-run agentic workflows across finance, operations, sales, marketing, HR, and customer service.
- The package offers 15 skills for repeatable tasks, including invoice chasing, margin analysis, month-end preparation, tax-season organization, contract review, lead triage, and content strategy.
- Claude for Small Business operates through Claude Cowork, where each connected tool handles specific jobs, with user approval required before actions are sent, posted, or paid.

**Why it matters:** This initiative aims to bridge the AI adoption gap between small businesses and larger enterprises by providing tailored, integrated AI solutions for common operational tasks.

`claude` `small-business` `ai` `workflows` `integrations`

### [Introducing Claude Haiku 4.5](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-haiku-4-5)

**Anthropic** · 2026-07-22

Anthropic released Claude Haiku 4.5, a small model offering near-frontier coding performance at one-third the cost and more than twice the speed of Claude Sonnet 4, available to all users.

- Claude Haiku 4.5 achieves similar coding performance to Claude Sonnet 4 but at 1/3 the cost and >2x the speed.
- It surpasses Claude Sonnet 4 in tasks like computer use and achieves 90% of Sonnet 4.5's performance in Augment's agentic coding evaluation.
- Pricing for Claude Haiku 4.5 is $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens.
- It runs up to 4-5 times faster than Sonnet 4.5 and can be orchestrated in parallel for subtasks by Sonnet 4.5.
- In instruction-following for slide text generation, Claude Haiku 4.5 achieved 65% accuracy, compared to 44% from a premium tier model.

**Why it matters:** This model provides a cost-efficient and fast option for AI applications requiring real-time, low-latency performance, such as chat assistants, customer service, and pair programming.

`claude-haiku-4-5` `ai-model` `coding-performance` `cost-efficiency` `speed`

### [Claude Opus 4.6](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-4-6)

**Anthropic** · 2026-07-22

Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.6, an upgraded model with enhanced agentic coding, computer use, and tool use capabilities, featuring a 1M token context window in beta and improved performance on various benchmarks.

- Opus 4.6 achieves the highest score on Terminal-Bench 2.0 for agentic coding and leads on Humanity’s Last Exam, a multidisciplinary reasoning test.
- It outperforms OpenAI’s GPT-5.2 by 144 Elo points and Claude Opus 4.5 by 190 points on GDPval-AA, an evaluation for economically valuable knowledge work.
- The model introduces a 1M token context window in beta, compaction for longer-running tasks via API, and adaptive thinking with new effort controls.
- Opus 4.6 demonstrates improved coding skills, better code review and debugging, and enhanced ability to operate in larger codebases.

**Why it matters:** These advancements enable more reliable and autonomous AI performance across complex tasks in coding, finance, research, and general knowledge work.

`llm` `opus-4-6` `agentic-coding` `1m-context-window` `benchmarks`
